entities.name: Yert
entities.description: Moriok from the Mephidross on Mirrodin who later became a vampire and overthrew Geth.

entities.name: Geth
entities.description: Lord of the Mephidross who ordered Yert to kill Glissa; beheaded by Yert.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: Opponent of Yert who was frozen in time and later teleported inside him.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Ordered Yert to take Glissa alive.

entities.name: Bruenna
entities.description: Escaped Yert's control and rescued Glissa.

entities.name: Krark-Home
entities.description: Place Yert attacked in the Oxidda Chain.

entities.name: Miracore
entities.description: Power Glissa used to teleport inside Yert.

events.summary: Glissa, Slobad and Bosh slaughter Yert's Reaper; Yert agrees to help her.
events.quote: Yert agreed to help her achieve her goals

events.summary: Yert is fed to Geth's wounded vampire, ensuring the traitor's death.
events.quote: So Yert was fed to the vampire

events.summary: Yert rises as a vampire and overthrows Geth after beheading him.
events.quote: he overthrew Geth after beheading him

events.summary: Yert lures Glissa into a trap and freezes her in time.
events.quote: He lured her into a trap and froze her in time

events.summary: Glissa teleports inside Yert, who explodes into little pieces.
events.quote: Glissa teleported inside Yert, who exploded into little pieces
